content: [Slack #security-alerts Eve Liu Mon Jul 08 2024 11:00] New finding: CVE-2024-6409 just disclosed. Related to regreSSHion but different — affects sshd's privilege separation child process. CVSS 7.0 (vs 6387's 8.1). Key difference: CVE-2024-6409 only affects OpenSSH versions 8.7 and 8.8 (specific RHEL backport versions), not the full 8.5p1-9.7p1 range of CVE-2024-6387. Files added to workspace update. Please add comparison analysis.

CVE-2024-6409 logged. Distinct from CVE-2024-6387: different scope (child process vs main), different CVSS (7.0 vs 8.1), narrower version range (8.7+8.8 only vs 8.5p1-9.7p1). Will produce comparison analysis in work/cve_comparison.json.
